x: A.A.A. and those of you who wish to be kept abreast of County news, statistics, and results, are advised to obtain 'SCAN', Surrey's excellent news-letter, which costs only 2/6d for a year's supply of three copies. An order can be placed with it's Editors J.

Regretfully we to have to record the passing of John Martell who died on June 1st after an illness which had troubled him for some years. John was a greatly respected man, having served as Treasurer of the Amateur Athletic Association from 1971 to 1975 and then again from 1982 until 1986.
